inferences.text: WslService stops with 1058 because OnServiceStarting() finds IWslSupport unregistered. The inbox component that would register it (wslsupport.dll / Microsoft-Windows-Subsystem-Linux inside Lxss-Optional-Package) is staged and disabled, not projected into System32.

Get-FeatureInfo 0x800f080c is consistent with a staged-only package: the feature exists inside the package (Disabled) but is not in the live optional-feature catalog until the package is installed/enabled.
A reboot alone is not expected to create the missing HKLM interface key or expand DCS payloads. No WSL pending file rename; no CBS/WU reboot-pending flag.
CBS CurrentState 64 for Lxss-Optional matches DISM 状态=暂存. Enabled VMP package 26100.2314 is CurrentState 112.
